scripts.dev: concurrently --raw -n daemon,web -c blue,green "bun run daemon" "cd packages/web && bun run dev"
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --filter '@corvran/web' build
scripts.start: concurrently --raw -n daemon,web -c blue,green "bun run daemon" "cd packages/web && bun run start"
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '@corvran/shared' lint && bun run --filter '@corvran/backend' lint && bun run --filter '@corvran/web' lint
